add_1ml_core_grip.label: Add 1mL CO-RE Grip
add_1ml_core_grip.description: Add a 1mL CO-RE gripper tool to the layout.

add_5ml_core_grip.label: Add 5mL CO-RE Grip
add_5ml_core_grip.description: Add a 5mL CO-RE gripper tool to the layout.

add_carrier.label: Add Carrier
add_carrier.description: Add a carrier definition to the active deck layout.

labware_definition.label: Labware Definition
labware_definition.help: Catalog value string, e.g. 'TIP_CAR_480BC' (see LABWARE.CARRIER.* in hamilton_venus.catalog)

add_carrier_to_site.label: Add Carrier To Site
add_carrier_to_site.description: Add a carrier definition to a specific site on an existing carrier.

labware_definition.label: Labware Definition
labware_definition.help: Catalog value string, e.g. 'TIP_CAR_480BC' (see LABWARE.CARRIER.* in hamilton_venus.catalog)

add_channel_liquid_waste.label: Add Channel Liquid Waste
add_channel_liquid_waste.description: Add a channel liquid waste site to the layout.

add_lid.label: Add Lid
add_lid.description: Add a standalone lid to a carrier site.

add_lidded_plate.label: Add Lidded Plate
add_lidded_plate.description: Add a lidded plate; returns both plate and lid names.

add_liquid_waste.label: Add Liquid Waste
add_liquid_waste.description: Add a liquid waste container to the layout (Vantage only).

add_ntr.label: Add Nested Tip Rack (NTR)
add_ntr.description: Add a nested tip rack to a carrier site.

add_plate.label: Add Plate
add_plate.description: Add a plate to a carrier site in the active layout.

add_qcg.label: Add QCG
add_qcg.description: Add a QCG gripper tool to the layout. Track is Vantage only (QCG occupies 2 tracks).

add_reservoir.label: Add Reservoir
add_reservoir.description: Add a reservoir to a carrier site in the active deck layout.

add_tip_box.label: Add Tip Box
add_tip_box.description: Add a tip box to a carrier site in the active layout.

labware_definition.label: Labware Definition
labware_definition.help: Catalog value string (see LABWARE.TIP_RACK.* in hamilton_venus.catalog)

carrier_id.label: Carrier ID
carrier_id.help: Deck instance ID of a tip-box carrier added via Add Carrier (e.g. LABWARE.CARRIER.HAM_MLTIPBOX_CAR_BASE_1ML) -- a regular tip-rack carrier such as TIP_CAR_480BC will not fit a tip box.

add_tip_rack.label: Add Tip Rack
add_tip_rack.description: Add a tip rack to a carrier site in the active layout.

labware_definition.label: Labware Definition
labware_definition.help: Catalog value string, e.g. 'HTF' (see LABWARE.TIP_RACK.* in hamilton_venus.catalog)

add_tip_support.label: Add Tip Support
add_tip_support.description: Add a tip support to a carrier site.

add_transport_site.label: Add Transport Site
add_transport_site.description: Add a custom transport site at explicit coordinates.

add_tube_carrier.label: Add Tube Carrier
add_tube_carrier.description: Add a sample tube carrier to the active layout.

add_tubes_to_carrier.label: Add Tubes To Carrier
add_tubes_to_carrier.description: Add tubes to positions on a tube carrier.

positions.label: Tube Positions
positions.help: Fetch the carrier's available sites, then assign a tube type (and optional x/y/z offsets) to each position you want to fill.

clear_taught_locations.label: Clear Taught Locations
clear_taught_locations.description: Empty both maps, leaving a canonical empty file in place.

deck_get_previous.label: Get Previous Deck
deck_get_previous.description: Return whether a previous deck layout is available.

deck_get_rack_ids_from_deck.label: Get Rack IDs From Deck
deck_get_rack_ids_from_deck.description: Return rack IDs found in a deck file.

deck_get_saved.label: Get Saved Decks
deck_get_saved.description: Return the list of saved deck layouts.

deck_import.label: Import Deck
deck_import.description: Import a deck layout from a file path.

deck_import_rack_as_site.label: Import Rack As Site
deck_import_rack_as_site.description: Import a rack from a deck file as a labware site.

deck_load.label: Load Deck
deck_load.description: Load a saved deck layout, or the previous deck.

deck_save.label: Save Deck
deck_save.description: Save the active deck layout under the given name.

get_added_carriers.label: Get Added Carriers
get_added_carriers.description: Return all carriers added to the active layout.

get_added_plates.label: Get Added Plates
get_added_plates.description: Return all plates added to the active layout.

get_added_reservoirs.label: Get Added Reservoirs
get_added_reservoirs.description: Return all reservoirs added to the active layout.

get_added_tip_racks.label: Get Added Tip Racks
get_added_tip_racks.description: Return all tip racks added to the active layout.

get_available_carrier_sites.label: Get Available Carrier Sites
get_available_carrier_sites.description: Return the available (unoccupied) sites on a carrier.

get_available_tracks.label: Get Available Tracks
get_available_tracks.description: Return the deck tracks currently available (unoccupied).

get_labware_coordinates.label: Get Labware Coordinates
get_labware_coordinates.description: Return one well's coordinates, or -- with no well -- the labware origin plus every well's coordinates (origin only for a carrier).

get_labware_location.label: Get Labware Location
get_labware_location.description: Return the location (carrier/site) of the specified labware.

get_labware_on_carrier.label: Get Labware On Carrier
get_labware_on_carrier.description: Return the labware currently placed on a carrier.

get_labware_positions.label: Get Labware Positions
get_labware_positions.description: Return all positions of the specified labware.

get_occupied_carrier_sites.label: Get Occupied Carrier Sites
get_occupied_carrier_sites.description: Return the occupied sites on a carrier.

get_occupied_tracks.label: Get Occupied Tracks
get_occupied_tracks.description: Return the deck tracks currently occupied.

get_split_wells.label: Get Split Wells
get_split_wells.description: Return the wells currently split, with their slots.

get_taught_locations.label: Get Taught Locations
get_taught_locations.description: Return the whole TaughtLocations.json (both keyed maps).

get_taught_offset.label: Get Taught Offset
get_taught_offset.description: Direct lookup of the offset recorded for a carrier/site.

get_taught_position.label: Get Taught Position
get_taught_position.description: Direct lookup of a labware item's position at one carrier/site.

get_taught_positions.label: Get Taught Positions
get_taught_positions.description: Every taught position for a labware item, keyed by "<carrier>/<site>".

get_tilted_labware.label: Get Tilted Labware
get_tilted_labware.description: Return every plate currently tilted, with its angle.

get_top_labware.label: Get Top Labware
get_top_labware.description: Return the topmost labware stacked at a carrier site.

get_transport_tool.label: Get Transport Tool
get_transport_tool.description: Return a transport tool matching the given filters (mutually exclusive).

get_transport_tool_ids.label: Get Transport Tool IDs
get_transport_tool_ids.description: Return all known transport tool IDs.

is_labware_tilted.label: Is Labware Tilted
is_labware_tilted.description: Whether Tilt Labware has left a plate tilted.

is_track_occupied.label: Is Track Occupied? (Status)
is_track_occupied.description: Query whether the specified deck track is occupied.

labware_add_definition.label: Add Labware Definition
labware_add_definition.description: Add a new labware definition from a full geometry object.

labware_definition.label: Labware Definition (JSON)
labware_definition.help: Full LabwareDefinition geometry object; see hamilton_venus.models for the schema

labware_get_definitions.label: Get Labware Definitions
labware_get_definitions.description: Return labware definitions, optionally filtered by name.

labware_get_params_from_id.label: Get Labware Params From ID
labware_get_params_from_id.description: Return labware definition parameters for a placed labware ID.

labware_get_types.label: Get Labware Types
labware_get_types.description: Return all known labware type names.

labware_update_definition.label: Update Labware Definition
labware_update_definition.description: Update an existing labware definition from a full geometry object.

move_carrier.label: Move Carrier
move_carrier.description: Move a carrier to a new site.

register_taught_offset.label: Register Taught Offset
register_taught_offset.description: Record a relative X/Y/Z (+ angle) correction for a carrier/site, keyed "<carrier>/<site>".

register_taught_position.label: Register Taught Position
register_taught_position.description: Record absolute X/Y/Z (+ angle) coordinates for a labware item at a carrier/site.

remove_labware.label: Remove Labware
remove_labware.description: Remove labware from the active layout.

remove_split_wells.label: Remove Split Wells
remove_split_wells.description: Remove split wells; pipetting goes to the well centres again.

remove_taught_offset.label: Remove Taught Offset
remove_taught_offset.description: Delete one carrier/site offset. Returns True if it existed.

remove_taught_position.label: Remove Taught Position
remove_taught_position.description: Delete one carrier/site combination for a labware, or -- with carrier and site left blank -- every taught position for it.

remove_transport_tool.label: Remove Transport Tool
remove_transport_tool.description: Remove a transport tool from the layout.

resolve_taught_location.label: Resolve Taught Location
resolve_taught_location.description: Resolve the way VENUS does: labware-at-site first, then the carrier/site offset.

shift_labware.label: Shift Labware
shift_labware.description: Shift labware's position relative to its current placement.

split_wells.label: Split Wells
split_wells.description: Let several channels pipette side by side into large wells (6/12/24-well, 50 mL tubes): places channel-pitch slots in each well; pipetting with 2+ channels on a split well is routed to its slots automatically.

wells.label: Wells
wells.help: Selector without the labware, e.g. A1, A1:B3, row:A.

channel_type.label: Channel Type
channel_type.help: 1 mL channels (9 mm pitch) or 5 mL channels (18 mm).

fit.label: Fit
fit.help: Position: keep the aim (at a wall: as many channels as fit, as close as they fit). Max channels: most channels, moving away from the aim only as needed.

tip_end_height_mm.label: Tip End Height (mm)
tip_end_height_mm.help: Tip end above the well floor; defaults to tilt_labware's, else 0.

wall_margin_mm.label: Low Wall Margin (mm)
wall_margin_mm.help: Gap kept to the low wall; defaults to tilt_labware's, else 1.0.

high_wall_margin_mm.label: High Wall Margin (mm)
high_wall_margin_mm.help: Gap kept to the high wall; defaults to tilt_labware's, else 2.0.

tilt_labware.label: Tilt Labware
tilt_labware.description: Offset every well of a plate to match a tilt (0-10 degrees; 0 returns it to flat). Plates only; transport is refused while tilted. Does not move the tilt hardware.

tilt_degrees.label: Tilt (degrees)
tilt_degrees.help: The angle the tilt module is commanded to, 0 (flat) to 10; fractions allowed.

pivot_x_offset_mm.label: Pivot X Offset (mm)
pivot_x_offset_mm.help: Measured hinge offset from the pivot point; positive toward -X.

pivot_z_offset_mm.label: Pivot Z Offset (mm)
pivot_z_offset_mm.help: Measured hinge offset below the labware base; positive toward -Z.

well_position.label: Well Position
well_position.help: Aim at the well centre, or as close to the low (deepest) or high wall as one tip fits.

measured_tilt_degrees.label: Measured Tilt (degrees)
measured_tilt_degrees.help: The angle the plate really sits at, if not the commanded one (e.g. 10.8); up to 15.

tip_end_height_mm.label: Tip End Height (mm)
tip_end_height_mm.help: Tip end above the well floor (the fixed height); 0 is the most conservative.

wall_margin_mm.label: Low Wall Margin (mm)
wall_margin_mm.help: Gap kept between the tip and the low wall.

high_wall_margin_mm.label: High Wall Margin (mm)
high_wall_margin_mm.help: Gap kept between the tip and the high wall, which leans in over the tip.
